scope: Fixed offline synthetic message-path and latency benchmark; no native dataset replay, independent physical source, held-out driving result or full published-method reproduction
generator: Synthetic latent speed=5000+20*i mm/s, candidate=latent+200, anchor=latent+250*(i modulo2), timestamp=1000000+20000*i us; n=128. Active interval indexes[n/4,3n/4); missing research assumption and revoked anchor apply throughout. No fitting or threshold search.
faults: Bias adds3000mm/s; tampering changes speed after signing; replay repeats last pre-interval wire with current receipt; context changes signed capture ID; anchor stale measurement is now-100001us with fresh receipt; clock rollback fixes now/receipt/measurement one us below last pre-interval now; database rollback restores the explicit initial temporary state once and replays last pre-interval wires.
reference_controls: Unsigned control reads candidate value without MAC, freshness, context or state. Authenticated control verifies candidate with the existing guard but has no anchor/risk selector. These are limited component controls, not native published AV security baselines. Extra anchor information and risk semantics differ explicitly.
timing: perf_counter_ns around the actual decision call, including parsing, HMAC checks and SQLite open/transaction/full-sync/close where used. Exclude key generation, signing, scenario construction, initial database creation, explicit adversary snapshot restore, logging and verification. Include every decision, including rejections. No timing threshold, warmup exclusion, repeats selection or production deadline claim.
evidence: Fresh per-case/policy ephemeral keys and temporary state only; no keys, wires or native signatures retained. Freeze code/parameters before scoring; save decision/timing ledger and compare every output to a separate deterministic protocol oracle; independently reduce errors and timing. Post-run verification does not recheck discarded MAC keys or remeasure latency.
metrics: All requests and before/during/after phases; admission coverage; disagreement against known generated latent value; accepted >2m/s counts; unchanged0.5m/s P95/95%coverage/zero-large-disagreement gates; per-call median/P95/max milliseconds; restricted-context output and replay-evidence-used counts. Latent reference is synthetic, not physical truth.
negative_controls: Matching false signed reports can defeat the integrated selector; restoring old local replay state can admit a replay while measurement age is still fresh. Preserve these failures. Expected scenario conformity is not a security-success or journal-readiness flag.
